::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 17th 1865  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 102
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)
Thanks for repairing the omission. I believe ladies always enjoy gentlemen doing what they are so apt to do themselves.[^1]

I enclose my [brother](people/person_1624.qmd)s biscuits, much hoping they may answer the purpose.[^2]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: He had sent her an unsigned cheque.
[^2]: JBY wanted to publish an article on the Huntley and Palmer biscuit factory at Reading in *Macmillan's Magazine*.
